name: sanction
description: One-off human approvals for exact AI agent actions, plus approval and budget checks before spending, tool use, or new capabilities. Hosted MCP is cooperative: the host must ask and honor the answer. Route upstream MCP tools through /mcp/broker/<name> for enforced tool decisions.

profiles.description: Approval-focused profile for AI hosts: 8 tools. Excludes execution-token issuance and vault credential retrieval.
Full wallet profile: 10 tools, also available over stdio as sanction-mcp. Adds scoped execution tokens and credential retrieval from the encrypted vault.

SANCTION_API_KEY.description: Agent API key (prefix: pxy_). Obtain from your Sanction wallet dashboard.

SANCTION_API_URL.description: Sanction API base URL. Defaults to https://getsanction.com/api/v1.

SANCTION_WALLET_ID.description: Optional wallet-status override; the wallet is derived from the agent key by default.

tools.name: sanction_authorize
tools.description: Ask before any purchase, subscription, or transfer.

tools.name: sanction_authorize_provision
tools.description: Ask before provisioning seats, licenses, or infrastructure.

tools.name: sanction_authorize_tool
tools.description: Ask before invoking another tool, shell command, deploy, or send.

tools.name: sanction_authorize_capability
tools.description: Ask before acquiring a skill, plugin, or new API.

tools.name: sanction_check_authorization
tools.description: Poll an escalated request for its one-use grant.

tools.name: sanction_log_tokens
tools.description: Record LLM token usage against the wallet's budgets.

tools.name: sanction_log_outcome
tools.description: Record a confirmed business outcome for cost-per-outcome ceilings.

tools.name: sanction_request_execution
tools.description: Mint a short-lived mandate (execution JWT) for a child agent or counterparty.

tools.name: sanction_inject_credential
tools.description: Retrieve a vaulted secret under that mandate. Audit-logged.

tools.name: sanction_wallet_status
tools.description: Today and month-to-date spend, token cost, and pending approvals.
